_comment: Shared truth for public.contains_contact_info() and its TypeScript twin in
src/lib/contact-info.ts. Both are tested against this one file: the Vitest suite reads it
directly, and scripts/gen-contact-info-parity.mjs turns it into a pgTAP suite. If the two
implementations ever drift, one of them fails.
CLAUDE.md says 'change one, change both'. This is what makes that enforceable rather than

blocked.text: find us at recovery.net, open late
blocked.why: bare domain followed by a comma
bare domain with a query string

allowed.text: Stuck in mud past the hubs
Buried to the frame off FM 1431

allowed.why: year and size, no phone shape

allowed.text: About 200 yards past the second gate
Need a tractor, truck is 8000 lb
Off CR 340 near the river crossing
Rained 3 days straight so it is soft

_known_limits: These cases document behaviour, including behaviour that is arguably too eager. A 10-digit
run is blocked wherever it appears, so a very long VIN or a GPS string pasted into a public
notes field is rejected too. That is the intended trade: the field is public, and a false
rejection costs somebody one edit while a false accept publishes a phone number.
